The issuer appears to have a solid balance sheet, with moderate leverage (liabilities about 52% of assets), healthy equity support, strong accumulated retained earnings, and adequate liquidity via a 1.39x current ratio. Profitability is positive but not especially strong relative to the asset base, which keeps the credit profile in the lower end of the high-grade / upper-medium-grade range rather than the very top tiers.

DECISION: A-
